words.example: An invalid request with no patient name cannot be processed today.
words.exampleZh: 没有患者姓名的无效请求，今天无法办理。

words.example: Send any incomplete form back before it reaches the file room.
words.exampleZh: 不完整的表格在送到档案室之前请退回去。

words.example: The missing field on page one is the patient's date of birth.
words.exampleZh: 第一页的漏填字段是患者的出生日期。

words.example: The wrong date on the leave form pushed the claim into last month.
words.exampleZh: 请假表上日期填错了，这笔申报被算进了上个月。

words.example: The signature is illegible, so we cannot see who approved the form.
words.exampleZh: 签名字迹难认，看不出是谁批准了这份表格。

words.example: The mailbox database for nursing grew quickly after the new ward opened.
words.exampleZh: 新病区启用后，护理部的邮箱数据库涨得很快。

words.example: Her mailbox quota is full, so the shift roster bounced back.
words.exampleZh: 她的邮箱配额满了，排班表因此被退了回来。

words.example: Older messages move into her archive mailbox when the main box fills.
words.exampleZh: 主邮箱一满，较旧的邮件就会进到她的归档邮箱。

words.example: Litigation hold keeps every message in that mailbox until the case ends.
words.exampleZh: 在案件结束前，诉讼保留会留下该邮箱的每一封邮件。

words.example: An in-place hold preserves deleted mail without moving it elsewhere.
words.exampleZh: 就地保留会留下已删除的邮件，而不把它挪到别处。
